scope: Actual Cloudflare D1 Console observation after immediate-close request, before three-second-linger attempt
timestampPrecision: bounded by the two preserved request events; no exact Console capture timestamp was saved
query: SELECT id,state,payload_hash,delete_requested,issue_number,(payload IS NULL) AS payload_is_null,created,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE id='083ca5ca-d1f4-44f6-9a3e-1c32f8850cc9') AS identity_rows FROM feedback WHERE id='083ca5ca-d1f4-44f6-9a3e-1c32f8850cc9';
interpretation: No persisted row was observed for this attempt. Request bytes written did not establish durable receipt. The later linger attempt and authenticated status GET are separate evidence.
capturePitfall: When a query returns no data the first table in the Console DOM belongs to an older query. Root read the query and its no-data message together and did not treat that older table as proof.
